source.sqlReaderQuery:
select
BU_Cd,
BU_NmCn,
BU_NmEn,
BU_Desc,
Parent_BU_Cd,
BU_Type,
Business_Domain,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
'DIM_BU' as Etl_Src,
'DM_DIM_BU' as Etl_Job,
Etl_Tm
from
NESZ_DIM.DIM_BU

SELECT
Channel_Cd,
Channel_DescCn,
Channel_DescEn,
Channel_DescBias,
Channel_Type_Cd,
Chnanel_Type_Nm,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
Etl_Tm
from 
NESZ_DIM.DIM_Channel

select
Code_Value_Src,
Code_Desc_Cn,
Code_Desc_En,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
Etl_Tm
from [NESZ_DIM].[DIM_Code_Value_H]
where Code_Domain_Code='PRD000002'

SELECT  DISTINCT T1.CST_UNIID,
T1.CST_NO,
T1.CST_NAM ,
T1.CST_SAL_ORG,
T1.CST_DST_CHL,
Case WHEN T1.CST_INA_FLG='N' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END as [1],
T1.CST_STA_DT,
T1.CST_END_DT,
GETDATE() as [2] 
FROM [MVIEW].[MDM_CST_MST_MV] T1

SELECT 
T1.STR_UNIID,
T1.STR_NO,
T1.STR_NAM,
T1.STR_TYP_ID,
T1.STR_TYP,
CASE 
WHEN  STR_DTR_CD='1000000LEYYOUGROUP' then
(CASE WHEN
T1.STR_TYP_ID='n' or (T1.STR_TYP_ID='v' and T4.WHS_TYP_CD='n') 
then 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END)
WHEN  STR_DTR_CD='1000000KIDSWANTGROUP' then
'FALSE'
ELSE 'FALSE' END,
CASE 
WHEN  STR_DTR_CD='1000000LEYYOUGROUP' then
(CASE WHEN
T1.STR_TYP_ID in ('v','DSCCSDMV')
then 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END)
WHEN  STR_DTR_CD='1000000KIDSWANTGROUP' then
'FALSE'
ELSE 'FALSE' END,
NULL,
T1.STR_DTR_CD,
T1.STR_DTR_NM,
T1.NTS_REG_CD,
T1.NTS_REG_DES,
T1.STR_POV_CD,
T1.STR_POV_DES,
T1.STR_CTG_CD,
T1.STR_CTG_M_DES_C,
T1.STR_CTG_M_DES_E,
T1.STR_CTY_CD,
T1.STR_CTY_DES,
NULL,
NULL,
ISNULL(T1.STR_DEF_REG_DES,'undefined'),
ISNULL(T1.STR_DEF_REG,'undefined'),
T4.WHS_UNIID,
T1.STR_SCD,
T1.STR_SNM,
case when T1.STR_XZ = 'Y' then 'TRUE' else 'FALSE' end,
T1.STR_ACT,
Case when T1.STR_INA_FLG='Y' then 'TRUE' else 'FALSE' END,
T1.STR_STA_DT,
T1.STR_END_DT,
DATEADD(hh,8,getdate())
FROM 
[MVIEW].MDM_STR_MST_MV  T1
LEFT JOIN [MVIEW].MDM_WHS_MST_MV T4 ON T1.STR_DTR_CD = T4.WHS_DTR_CD and T4.WHS_CD = T1.STR_SCD and 
T4.WHS_INA_FLG!='Y'

SELECT
T1.WHS_UNIID,
T1.WHS_CD,
T1.WHS_NM,
NULL [1],
T1.WHS_DTR_CD,
T1.WHS_DTR_NM,
T1.NTS_REG_CD,
T1.NTS_REG_DES,
T1.WHS_POV_CD,
T1.WHS_POV_DES,
T1.WHS_CTG_CD,
T1.WHS_CTG_M_DES,
T1.WHS_CTG_M_DES_E,
T1.WHS_CTY_CD,
T1.WHS_CTY_DES,
NULL [2],
NULL [3],
T1.WHS_DEF_REG_DES,
T1.WHS_DEF_REG,
T1.WHS_SCD,
T1.WHS_SNM,
T1.WHS_TYP_CD,
T1.WHS_TYP_DES,
case when T1.WHS_TYP_CD in ('0','n','nn','z','xz') then 1 
when T1.WHS_TYP_CD in ('1','2','c','xc') then 2
else 0 end [4],
case when T1.WHS_TYP_CD in ('0','n','nn','z','xz') then N'门店仓库'
when T1.WHS_TYP_CD in ('1','2','c','xc') then N'客户大仓'
else N'其他' end [5],
CASE 
WHEN  WHS_DTR_CD='1000000LEYYOUGROUP' then
(CASE WHEN
T1.WHS_TYP_CD in ('n')
then 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END)
WHEN  WHS_DTR_CD='1000000KIDSWANTGROUP' then
'FALSE'
ELSE 'FALSE' END as Is_Franchise,
CASE 
WHEN  WHS_DTR_CD='1000000LEYYOUGROUP' then
(CASE WHEN
T2.STR_TYP_ID in ('v','DSCCSDMV')
then 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END)
WHEN  WHS_DTR_CD='1000000KIDSWANTGROUP' then
'FALSE'
ELSE 'FALSE' END as Is_Virtual,

Case when T1.WHS_INA_FLG='Y' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END [6],
T1.WHS_STA_DT,
T1.WHS_END_DT,
dateadd(hh,8, GETDATE()) [7] FROM  [MVIEW].MDM_WHS_MST_MV T1
LEFT JOIN [MVIEW].MDM_STR_MST_MV T2 ON T2.STR_DTR_CD = T1.WHS_DTR_CD and T1.WHS_CD = T2.STR_SCD 
and T2.STR_INA_FLG!='Y'
